about_the_game:
In this demo you can explore a portion of the world, missions and features of The Legend of Khiimori. Collect resources, craft useful items, breed, train, and care for your horses, but most importantly plan your routes wisely to survive the challenging conditions of 13th century Mongolia!

What’s Included in the Demo:

Many Riding Opportunities
Navigate a large world of around 2km² with some delivery opportunities generated through a dynamic dispatch system. Choose your destinations, optimize your routes, and earn your place as a legendary courier rider.

 

Bond with your Horse
Build a meaningful connection with your horse through feeding, grooming, and responsive riding mechanics. Improve its traits and responsiveness through time and care.

 

Authentic Horse Breeding System
Combine a limited number of traits from real-world horse genetics to breed horses with unique appearances and performance characteristics, featuring one historically-inspired Mongolian breed in this demo, and many more breeds to come in the full game.

 

Crafting & Resource Gathering
Gather materials from the land to craft tools, supplies, and upgrades, with 30 recipes included in the demo to aid you on your travels.

 

Strategic Route Planning
Make use of elevation maps, and local knowledge from NPCs to plot safe and effective delivery routes in a harsh environment. Navigate using your compass and set waypoints to map your own journey. A minimap will be added to the full game.

 

Simulation-Driven World
Face realistic survival challenges such as hunger, weather exposure, and terrain navigation. Currently 10 ground types exist in the demo and a dynamic weather system influences how your journey unfolds.

 

Demo Features:

  • Open world exploration in a part of the map

  • Horse care and training

  • Horse breeding based on real horse genetics (one Mongolian horse breed in the demo)

  • Resource gathering and item crafting (30 recipes in the demo)

  • Route planning and maps

  • Survival elements and environmental challenges (even more challenges to come with full release)

  • Multiple stats and values such as health and stamina

The demo is playable in English only, more languages will be added with release of the full game

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit or later (Windows 11 recommended for Intel 12th and 13th gen CPUs)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700K / AMD Ryzen 7 2700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 (6GB) / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT (6GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 16 GB available space

  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit or later (Windows 11 recommended for Intel 12th and 13th gen CPUs)

  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti (8GB) / AMD RX 6700 XT (12GB)
